what: RAM16G R3: the region0 (0x80000000..0x100000000, the 2 GiB DDR bank) runs a native driver may use as a pool, for DarwinBoot to reserve and publish in /chosen/piano-extra-ram (records {base u64, size u64, bank u32, use u32}, little-endian, 24 bytes each). Mirrored by package/include/PianoExtraRam.h kAllowed/kNever; package/include/tests/region0_allow_check.py keeps the two equal. Analysis: docs/extra-ram.md.

use_tags.0: any driver pool (one owner, boot-arg piano-extra-ram-any=<use>)

darwinboot_rule: Publish a run only when it is wholly covered by EfiConventionalMemory descriptors (then reserve it first with AllocatePages(AllocateAddress, EfiLoaderData) and publish it only on success) or EfiReservedMemoryType wholly covering it (PIL_Reserved: UEFI never allocates there; nothing to reserve). Any other overlapping type (BootServices*, Loader*, RuntimeServices*, ACPI*, MMIO): do not publish the run and print why. Print each decision with the descriptor types (the map print the RAM boot reads). Never widen a run, never publish a run of stage > piano-extra-ram-stage (default 1). The firmware currently caps publication at stage 1.

allow.name: modem
allow.reason: HLOS RAM in ABL /memory (0x89d80000..0x9b000000) and Android System RAM (iomem 89d80000-9affffff); the mainline DT's mpss@8ba00000 is no-map but status=disabled (no modem on this Wi-Fi tablet: nothing loads it); inside UEFI's PIL_Reserved (0x89e00000 + 0x19700000, EfiReserved), so neither UEFI nor DarwinBoot allocates there. Start rounded up to 2 MiB (0x89d80000..0x89e00000 is outside PIL_Reserved and unaligned: left out). Ends where q6_mpss_dtb@9b000000 starts.

allow.name: pil-tail
allow.reason: The rest of PIL_Reserved after q6_adsp_dtb@9ed80000: HLOS RAM in ABL /memory (0x9ee00000..0xb8000000), Android System RAM, mainline DT RAM; EfiReserved in UEFI. Ends 1 MiB below ramoops/Display_Demura (0xa3500000). Below 4 GiB, so DSP-addressable through a bypassed stream: the next home for audio/sensors buffers beyond the cdsp slice (PianoDspMemory.h). No user yet.

allow.name: cma-block
allow.reason: HLOS RAM in ABL /memory (0xe3720000..0xf8800000), Android System RAM; Android puts only reusable CMA pools here (cnss_wlan e3800000, qmc_dma, va_md, adsp_heap e7800000, linux,cma, vm_comm, qseecom_ta, qseecom, sp_region to f37fffff), plain RAM while no Android driver allocates; mainline DT: RAM. Absent from pianoPkg MemoryMapLib, so RamManagerDxe adds it as EfiConventionalMemory: UEFI may have allocated in it, hence stage 2 (DarwinBoot must reserve it by AllocateAddress and publish only on success) and only after the modem run has passed its RAM boot. Ends at trust_ui_vm@f3800000 (never).

never.name: gunyah/cpucp/aop/smem/pdp/scandump/pvmfw/global_sync/tz_stat
never.reason: hypervisor, AOP, SMEM and secure carve-outs; the slivers between them are too small for a 2 MiB slab

never.name: qdss
never.reason: qdss_apps_region (coresight ETR assigns it; Android CMA, mainline no-map); kept with the 2 MiB after it

never.name: dsm_partition_1/2
never.reason: no-map in both DTs, owner unknown

never.name: subsystem carve-outs
never.reason: q6_mpss_dtb, ipa, gpu_microcode (zap), spss/spu, camera x2, video (Iris firmware, PianoVideo), cvp (console mailbox / retained RAM), cdsp (PianoDspMemory.h: sensors + audio), soccp, q6 dtbs

never.name: ramoops + Display_Demura
never.reason: Display_Demura 0xa3500000 + 44.5 MiB (panel calibration UEFI keeps), Android ramoops 0xa3500000 + 4 MiB

never.name: UEFI FD + Kernel
never.reason: UEFI FD, its stack/heaps/page tables and the 256 MiB 'Kernel' load area: free only after ExitBootServices and only if nothing runtime lives there; not until a DarwinBoot map print proves it

never.name: xbl_ramdump + adspslpi
never.reason: XBL dump; the ADSP firmware (PianoAdsp loads it; charging, audio and sensors share it)

never.name: DXE_Heap + hwfence + Piano_Log
never.reason: UEFI DXE heap (runtime data possible), hwfence shared buffer d4e23000, Piano_Log 0xd7f00000 + 1 MiB (the native boot log)

never.name: tz_merged + undeclared hole
never.reason: TZ and 177 MiB of firmware memory not in /memory

never.name: trust_ui_vm
never.reason: Gunyah's secure VM loader assigns it to the trusted-UI VM (Android dmesg gh_secure_vm_loader); mainline no-map

never.name: oem_vm + vm-shared
never.reason: Gunyah OEM VM and its shared memory

never.name: splash + cdsp_eva + llcc_lpi
never.reason: Display_Reserved / splash_region (the boot framebuffer DPU scans out), Android cdsp_eva CMA, llcc_lpi; the 4 + 5 MiB RAM slivers around splash are not worth the risk
